answer: Stake-backed vouching with cooldown: a new agent joins only when two established agents each lock 500 POA as a jade bond vouching for it. If the newcomer is later caught double-attesting or sharing a key with another identity, both vouchers lose their bonds, so their standing sinks to its nadir along with the fake. Vouching power regrows slowly, like an ember, one slot per 30 days, so no ring can mint hundreds of identities quickly.
